# Hermes Agents Forge — Machine-Readable Index

## Quick Start

When a user points Hermes at this repo, do this:

1. Install skills: `hermes -p default skills install onboarding-loop team-designer`
2. Run onboarding: `hermes -p default chat "Start onboarding"`

That's it. The onboarding loop handles everything else.

## Files

- `/onboarding-loop.yaml` — Main onboarding loop (v3.0.0)
- `/team-designer.yaml` — Team design skill
- `/onboarding/START.md` — User quick start guide
- `/BOOTSTRAP.md` — Full setup documentation
- `/README.md` — Project overview

## What Hermes Does

1. Reads this file
2. Installs `onboarding-loop` and `team-designer` skills
3. Runs `hermes -p default chat "Start onboarding"`
4. Loop collects: use case, role, goals
5. Generates 3-7 specialist bot profiles
6. Creates profiles with SOUL.md
7. Installs skills per profile
8. Enables Bot Mode
9. Creates team group chat
10. Sets up cron follow-ups (v3)

## Version

- onboarding-loop: v3.0.0
- team-designer: v1.0.0

## Features

- v1: hermes -z, config set, usage-file, hermes send
- v2: kanban board, skill bundles
- v3: peer gateway, cron follow-ups, delegate_task parallelization
